rows: This is the level that quietly ends most people's attempt. Single-group pass rates run higher (16-25%), but clearing both groups together is brutally rare.
Even after surviving Foundation, Intermediate, and 2-3 years of articleship, the final hurdle still fails the majority of attempts.
